Defense Threat Reduction Agency Advertisement A nuclear explosion in space would be unlikely to cause widespread injuries on Earth. But it could disable satellites that provide services we depend on every day, including some that save lives. In the United States , satellite failures could make it harder for emergency crews to communicate in remote areas. If GPS were also disrupted, drivers and pilots could lose navigation guidance , and financial networks could lose a source of precise time. We have some idea of what would happen because it's already been done. What does history teach us? stories.summary: EU enlargement has regained momentum, with Montenegro and Albania moving closer to membership. But North Macedonia, a candidate since 2005, remains stalled by a politically difficult dispute involving Bulgaria.

stories.title: Gukesh to defend chess crown against rising star Sindarov
